hyperedges.label: Release pipeline: version, notes, pack, upload
Test projects (unit, integration, E2E) with shared TestHelper

nodes.label: Download list persistence (queue.json)
nodes.rationale: An unreadable queue.json is renamed to queue.json.corrupt instead of being overwritten, to avoid data loss.

nodes.label: User data in %LocalAppData%\TSRDownloader
nodes.rationale: Kept outside the program folder so it survives updates; dev builds keep it next to binaries.

nodes.label: Write release notes step (git log since previous tag)
nodes.norm_label: write release notes step (git log since previous tag)

nodes.label: Test stack (xUnit, NSubstitute, Shouldly, coverlet, StaFact)
nodes.norm_label: test stack (xunit, nsubstitute, shouldly, coverlet, stafact)
nodes.rationale: All tests deterministic and headless; StaFact where WPF requires an STA thread.

nodes.label: Versioning scheme v<Major.Minor>.<n>
nodes.rationale: Major.Minor is VersionPrefix in Directory.Build.props; n counts up automatically and restarts at 0 when prefix changes.

nodes.label: vpk pack / upload (Velopack packaging)
nodes.rationale: Previous release is downloaded first so vpk can build delta packages.

nodes.label: Manual update/release end-to-end check
nodes.rationale: Release workflow and real Velopack update can only be checked end to end against GitHub.

nodes.label: Automatic updates (Install automatically / Notify only / Off)
nodes.norm_label: automatic updates (install automatically / notify only / off)

nodes.label: Docs-only changes skip release (paths-ignore)
nodes.rationale: Every push to main ships a new 1.1.x release; docs/** and **/*.md changes do not.

nodes.label: Release concurrency group
nodes.rationale: Never run two releases at once - they would compute the same patch number.

nodes.label: Queue persistence tests (DownloadQueueStoreTests, DownloadQueueAutosaveTests, Restore_*, QueuePersistenceTests)
nodes.norm_label: queue persistence tests (downloadqueuestoretests, downloadqueueautosavetests, restore_*, queuepersistencetests)

nodes.label: TSR download wait / ticket
nodes.rationale: TSR requires a wait before download; raise it if downloads fail with invalid download ticket.

nodes.label: Dark Navy and Green Color Scheme
nodes.norm_label: dark navy and green color scheme

nodes.label: TSR Downloader App Icon (variant A)
nodes.rationale: Circular dark-navy badge with bold white 'TSR' wordmark, green 'DOWNLOADER' subtitle and green download-to-tray arrow; communicates the app's single purpose (downloading TSR content) at a glance.
